summary: This is a routine Form 6-K furnished by Woori Financial Group Inc., a Korean bank holding company, containing its Summary of 2026 First Quarter Business Report. The filing presents standard quarterly operating and financial results, including income statements, balance sheet data, and funding sources—all prepared under Korean IFRS. There is no mention of any special-situation corporate action such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or abrupt management change. The report is a normal periodic disclosure with no transactional catalyst. As a foreign private issuer filing under Rule 13a-16, this is the equivalent of a routine quarterly report akin to a 10-Q or 6-K earnings release. There are no deal terms to report.
